name: _PyAsyncGenASend_Send
reason: asendAmSend mirrors :2011-2021: async_gen_asend_send's value is PYGEN_NEXT, and its NULL (always with an exception set, async_gen_unwrap_value setting StopAsyncIteration when none is) goes to _PyGen_FetchStopIterationValue, a StopIteration's value being PYGEN_RETURN and anything else re-raised as PYGEN_ERROR; SendAsyncGenRules' second conjunct pins both outcomes over every state and SEND_ASYNC_GEN reaches it through the asend type's am_send, so a body that read StopAsyncIteration as a return or always answered PYGEN_NEXT fails.
